model_hint: Import nvngx_dlssnr.dll (310.9.16 or 310.8.0), its ZIP, or previously extracted BIN files. Model files are not distributed with the add-on.
remove_hint: Remove downloaded backend files and cached models? Installed game copies are preserved.
prepare_hint: Select the route and starting network. Installation applies these choices on the next launch.
choose_destination: Choose the folder containing the game executable.
complete_setup: Prepare the backend and model before installing in this game.
repair_hint: Install / repair resets the NR configuration to upstream defaults and the choices above.
settings_hint: Changes are saved in the installed configuration. Close the game before editing.
nr_menu: End opens NR Control. This shortcut controls the OptiScaler or ReShade menu; NR Control has its own hotkeys.
usage: Prepare the component and model in Manage, then install in the executable folder. Enable a compatible upscaler in the game. Open NR Control with End. Use PeliRun when starting from another launcher.
native: This integration targets Windows games running through Proton.
